area: Herdr-core composed ordering and runtime authority
properties: Delta ordering, missed cuts, heartbeat gaps, reconnect/restart, original lease/profile ownership, pre-send occupant/foreground fencing (including missing foreground), core-side source-queue fencing assumed under Q3, existing-only connect, kill confirmation (M7: no observed unconfirmed descendant and no replaced program ends; a child created after World's last observation is core's under Q11) and worktree removal order (P4: teardown only on a matching confirmation; the checkout only after the confirmed kill and under the planning generation, profile and core epoch), observe streams that never size, type or focus and paint every frame on core's announced grid; transcript publication keeps the original foreground and never promotes a reading link to input authority; automatic profile briefs require core idle at execution after queue/startup/draft waits; and typing that opens World's keyboard only on a genuine key, sends every key once and in order after the attach, refuses a replaced program, holds World's fitted size on a resumed seat that never resizes and swaps without a headless gap, and replies only on a touched seat
assessment: Bounded composed model. Replay drives the production CoreMirror for every mirror, cursor and readiness transition and the production read model for World's views, with five production negative controls (gap, heartbeat, stale, missed cut, view of a retired mirror); plan/kill and the worktree teardown replay the production coreKillPlan and coreKillRefusal with two production controls (pid-only confirmation, unconfirmed terminal passed); the checkout removal step is a design seam mapped to removeCoreWorktree's lease guard by its Bun and live-release suites; the observe family replays World's production watch attach/reply rules and page grid adoption with three more controls (typing attach, unconfirmed reply accepted, paint before its grid); the typing family drives the production CoreTypingSession and seat with three more (first key replayed, a seat that resizes, a swap that detaches before the new seat attaches); dispatch also drives the production recipient comparison with a missing-foreground action/control; capture/dispatch/deliver still use the design seam because the model checks the source occupant at dispatch while World can check only its observation. Foundation delivery history is not acceptance of this contract. Issue #874 maps transcript completion to capture/dispatch/complete with the publication-foreground model fault; exhaustive shared TUI format and harness matrix tests cover data mapping. The launchBrief action and brief-without-idle mutant map automatic brief readiness to the production native-parameter builder; source-side idle comparison remains a core-owned seam verified by native live and queued fake tests. Vendor harness credentials and Windows transcript reading are excluded. Native address grammar uses executed official-source vectors and in-process allocation across t19 to t1b, with RPC/schema, durable placement, labels, verified claims, Terminal/Files and browser-watch consumers; replacement and generation refusal also run at terminal 20. This adds no state transition to the ordering model; source grammar is checked directly rather than modeled. Town placement moves reuse the existing lease/epoch/occupant fence and core label dispatch. Real framed-core integration checks cover same-room and cross-room pane moves, multi-terminal desk moves, World/app topology reconciliation, unchanged programs and unrelated labels, inherited children staying behind, stale leases, vanished destinations, unavailable label capability, stopped partial moves and lost replies with no retry. Queue admission and publication boundary checks exercise the finite move schedules directly; desktop/touch canvas checks verify exact core RPC routing and success notices. Core offers no atomic multi-terminal transaction: failed writes report partial/unknown placement and never roll back over external edits. These direct consumer checks cover placement and failure mapping; the existing composed-ordering model supplies the reused authority contract, so no new Quint state machine is claimed.
remaining: Independent design/model review; a model split of observed versus actual occupant before the production fence can replace the authority seam; harness, browser/app and owner real-Windows relay acceptance in P2–P6. The Windows relay realizes the same existing-only connect (a probe reads core.lock, then one relay per generation opens exactly that pipe); it adds no ordering rule, so the model is unchanged and its evidence is the fake-pipe and real-PowerShell tests.
